text:
maria: heads-up — ListCo reported a spike of 5xx + client timeouts on hosted API around 08:12 UTC. p95 up from 120ms -> 850ms, p99 ~ 12s, a bunch of gateway 504s. stack traces point to long-tail request queueing and continuous-batcher backlog.

alex: grabbing traces now. did they change payload size or pattern?

maria: no app change on their side. sudden traffic burst from a scheduled job. they sent example request pattern — lots of concurrent short prompts (20–40 tokens) at bursty intervals.

leo: can you paste the gateway logs / recent queue metrics?

maria: logs snippet: 
```
2026-02-14T08:12:31Z WARN gateway request-queue depth=1024 limit=1024 tenant=listco route=/v1/generate enqueue-ms=1834
2026-02-14T08:12:31Z ERROR gateway dequeue-timeout tail-latency=12000ms req_id=ab12cd
2026-02-14T08:12:33Z WARN continuous-batcher backlog=78 kvcache-misses=92
```

maria: metrics: continuous_batch.backlog 60->120, request_queue.depth hitting limit 1024, queue.wait_ms p99=11.8s, kvcache.evictions up 80%.

alex: looks like the continuous-batcher can't keep up with small, bursty requests. prefix/KV cache churn causing evictions, leading to cold KV hits and long per-token latency.

ryan: any auth errors in the same window? we've seen token retry loops amplify queue pressure before.

maria: auth service returned 502s for ~200 calls during the spike — some clients retried aggressively. pattern matches earlier token-rotation retry storms.

leo: immediate mitigation options: 
- throttle ListCo at gateway (rate-limit to a steady token bucket)
- exclude them from continuous batching (per-tenant config) to avoid huge KV churn for their workload
- raise request queue limit temporarily (if infra headroom)

alex: I can flip per-tenant batching off and apply a soft throttle. which to run first?

maria: do batching off first — that should reduce KV churn. then apply throttle if tail persists.

alex: running command: 
```bash
# disable continuous batching for tenant listco
redwoodctl tenants update listco --continuous-batching=false
# apply soft throttle 200rps burst 400
redwoodctl rate-limit set tenant=listco rps=200 burst=400
```

ops-bot: action accepted — config change queued.

ops-bot: config update applied (txn id tx-9f3c).

maria: re-checking metrics — backlog dropping: continuous_batch.backlog 118 -> 14 in 45s, kvcache.evictions trending down. request_queue.depth now ~420. p99 latency down to 2.4s.

ryan: nice. still want to throttle more until auth team finishes the 502 root cause?

maria: yes please — keep soft throttle for 30m and monitor. created support ticket and notified ListCo.

leo: follow-up infra actions: investigate why KV cache evicted so aggressively (cache sizing, eviction policy), revisit default per-tenant batching heuristic for bursty small prompts.

alex: notes for runbook: reproduction steps we used: 
1) simulate 2k concurrent short prompts (20–40 tokens) to /v1/generate from single tenant with aggressive retries on 502.
2) observe continuous-batcher backlog climb and queue depth limit hit.
3) mitigation: disable continuous batching for tenant and apply rate-limit.

maria: paste a quick repro curl (non-auth simulation):
```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"open-small","input":"hi"}' &\ndone\nwait\n```

support-bot: ticket #SUP-4521 created for ListCo escalation. SLA: respond within 1 hour.

alex: we should also add a safety: if queue depth >= 90% for >1m for a tenant, auto-disable continuous batching and apply a conservative per-tenant throttle. open to objections?

ryan: +1. create an RFC and a short alert playbook.

maria: post-incident action items:
- engineering: tweak KV cache sizing and eviction thresholds (leo)
- infra: evaluate raising temporary queue_limit guardrails and autoscale path (alex)
- product: add per-tenant batching toggle in console + default heuristics for small prompt workloads (maria)
- support: template for communicating throttles to customers (support)

leo: capturing logs and traces to the incident folder. will follow up with a brief postmortem draft.

maria: thanks all — mitigation worked, ListCo back to normal traffic, leaving the soft throttle for 25 more minutes then revert if stable.

alex: reverting throttle at +30m if no regression. will update here. :thumbsup:
